title: [Master]-Sales/Purchase Price List activation allows Duplicate Lines when the Price List is Inactive.
summary: Activating an inactive sales or purchase price list no longer lets duplicate lines through. The fix is a one-line change in the Price List Management codeunit.
key_points: Price list activation no longer allows duplicate lines when the list was inactive
One-line change in codeunit 7017 Price List Management
New unit test added in Price List Header UT
